messages:
noah_sdk: Quick heads-up: fluttering retries in our Android SDK sample when network toggles during large uploads. Seems to be related to how Retrofit + OkHttp retryOnConnectionFailure interacts with our auth interceptor.

zee_qe: Can you paste the minimal repro? emulator/device?

noah_sdk: Pixel 7 emulator hitting flaky Wi-Fi. Flow: upload chunked files with multipart, interceptor adds Bearer header. If network drops mid-upload, OkHttp retries the request but the interceptor replays an expired token, leading to 401 and then another retry, then refresh storm.

omar_runtime: Ah, retryOnConnectionFailure will retry non-idempotent requests in some cases if the connection failed before request was sent. Multipart uploads are unsafe to retry by default. Make sure .retryOnConnectionFailure(false) or gate retries for POST/payloads.

noah_sdk: We had it on true for dev convenience. Disabling reduced duplicates but increased failed uploads for transient blips.

zee_qe: Two patterns we recommend: (1) make the Authenticator single-flight so only one refresh occurs; (2) mark non-idempotent requests with a header and have an interceptor skip automatic retry for those. Example pseudo: 
```kotlin
request.newBuilder().header("X-Idempotency", "false")
```
and Dispatcher's logic checks header.

omar_runtime: Also consider switching to a retry policy based on interceptor that checks if request body is repeatable. OkHttp can only retry if the body supports replay; otherwise it throws. For multipart, you can buffer small files but that's memory heavy.

noah_sdk: For the sample I changed retryOnConnectionFailure to false and added an AtomicReference single-flight refresh. Local runs look stable. Plan to add a short note in the SDK README recommending these settings for mobile uploads.

dev-bot: Reminder: open a follow-up issue with sampleapp link and label 'sdk-android-retries'.

zee_qe: Can you also add a tiny CI emulator test that toggles network during upload to catch regressions? Helps ensure we don't reintroduce retryOnConnectionFailure=true by accident.

noah_sdk: Will do. I'll push minimal repro under `android/samples/upload-retry-policy` and raise the issue. Thanks!
